body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-10-29 (Q2FY25 concall transcript): "we'd rather be conservative and outperform" Metric: Consolidated EBITDA margin. Target: ~11% (from ~10%). Deadline: FY27 (2-3 yrs from Oct-2024). Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: pending. Evidence: FY26 10.3%; H1FY27 ~10.6%; FY27 guided 10-11% (Oct-26), with an admission that expansion may fall short. Deadline FY27: on track to fall short unless H2 margin exceeds 11%.
